description.value: La Meza Grill is a family-owned Filipino restaurant that has been serving traditional regional cuisine in North Delta since June 2014. The extensive menu draws on culinary traditions from across the Philippine archipelago — from grilled chicken inasal and pork sisig to breakfast silog plates — offering a hungry cyclist a substantial and flavourful sit-down meal. DoorDash delivery is also available for those who prefer to eat on the go.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active full-service Filipino restaurant at 11955 88 Ave, Delta, BC with phone 604.501.0963 — address and URL match OSM, though OSM carries no phone number. Takeout is confirmed by a dedicated 'Party Tray Take Out' menu section and a DoorDash ordering link; vegetarian options (tofu sisig, fried vegetable spring roll, fresh lumpia, vegetable dishes) are present throughout the menu. No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, pump, or charging — are mentioned anywhere on the site.
